scientific_limits: Including0.01 in the grid does not guarantee equal or better outer held-sentence performance.

scope: Existing selected Figure3b population response, fixed30-component feature matrix, fixed layer/lags, original outer held-sentence split and scorer

tie_preference: Original0.01 if tied with maximum, otherwise smaller alpha
